description: This PHP source file defines the class `Article` within the Opencart admin controller namespace for catalog tasks. It handles generating JSON data files related to articles and countries, including listing, retrieving info, and clearing data. The class interacts with models for store, task, language, country, zone, and geo_zone, and manages file operations for saving JSON files.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Controller class for managing articles and country data files, including generation, retrieval, and cleanup tasks.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes tasks by adding clear and list tasks for articles and country operations, and schedules country-related tasks for each store and language.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Generates a JSON list of countries for a specific store and language, saving it to a file.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Generates detailed country information in JSON format and saves to file.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes previously generated country JSON files from the filesystem.
